description: The steel construction and padded contact points provide a sturdy and protective frame, which is essential for safely transporting your favorite watercraft. The lightweight design at 28lbs makes it manageable for most people to handle, and the adjustable dimensions accommodate different boat sizes. Ratchet straps offer a secure hold, ensuring peace of mind during transportation. The Rambo Kayak Trailer is a reliable solution for getting your kayak or canoe to the water hassle-free.
